resources.string: FeedShield detects short-form video UI layouts (Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts) to prevent doom-scrolling while keeping your standard feeds and direct messages accessible.
Intercept addictive short-form video algorithms without giving up social messaging or normal feeds.
FeedShield uses Accessibility APIs strictly to detect short-video UI layouts on Instagram and YouTube. No personal data, messages, or text inputs are recorded, stored, or transmitted.
Targeted UI inspection: Recognizes Reels and Shorts view containers in real-time.
Zero-Cloud Guarantee: 100% on-device processing. No network tracking.
Feed & Chat Intact: Standard posts, stories, searches, and DMs remain completely usable.
